description: Atlas Benchmark Registry — catalogs all supported evaluation benchmarks. Internal benchmarks are defined by Atlas; external benchmarks are registered as placeholders for future integration. No benchmark data is downloaded or stored.

atlas_quality_benchmark.purpose: Measure knowledge object factual correctness, completeness, and reasoning quality against curated Atlas data.

provenance_benchmark.purpose: Verify source attribution integrity and provenance chain completeness across knowledge objects.

review_agreement_benchmark.purpose: Measure inter-reviewer agreement and score consistency using Cohen's Kappa and related statistics.

mmlu.purpose: Massive Multitask Language Understanding — measure model knowledge across 57 academic subjects.

gsm8k.purpose: Grade School Math 8K — measure arithmetic reasoning ability via chain-of-thought.

humaneval.purpose: HumanEval — measure functional code generation correctness via pass@k.

arc.purpose: AI2 Reasoning Challenge — measure grade-school science reasoning ability.
